contextRecall.title: Context recall
contextRecall.description: Let the agent spend a little context on remembering: long sessions get a relevance-ranked recap of their older turns instead of a raw replay, and excerpts from your saved chats that match the current request are added ahead of it. Everything stays on this machine — the chat index is local. On by default.
contextRecall.budgetHint: Cap on the recap, in estimated tokens; recalled chat excerpts get half of it. 0 turns recall off. Default 1200.

localEngine.kvDescription: While a local model runs, it keeps the whole conversation so far on your graphics card. In a long chat that can take up more room than the model itself. Storing it more compactly frees that space — so a model that almost fits will fit, or the same model can hold a longer conversation. The cost is a little precision. Not sure? Leave it on Full.
localEngine.kvEffect_f16: Nothing is compressed — this is how your models run today. Pick one of the others only if a model will not fit.
localEngine.kvEffect_q8_0: Frees about a quarter of that memory, for a quality difference almost nobody can spot. The usual choice when a model is only just too big. (llama.cpp calls this q8_0.)
localEngine.kvEffect_q4_0: Frees about a third. This one you can notice — long conversations drift more. For when nothing else fits. (llama.cpp calls this q4_0.)
localEngine.kvRestartHint: {{model}} is loaded right now and keeps the setting it started with. Stop it and start it again for this to take effect.

adult.title: Adult content (18+)
adult.whatChanges: Turning this on switches Civitai browsing to civitai.red and shows models rated R, X and XXX alongside the rest. Previews above PG-13 are blurred until you click them, and no preview is ever saved to disk.
adult.never: Content involving real people or minors, anything Civitai has taken down, and anything flagged as blocked stays excluded in both modes. That filter takes no setting — there is no combination of options in this app that turns it off.
adult.keyPolicy: 18+ browsing also requires your own Civitai API key, stored above. That is our rule, not Civitai's: it ties adult browsing to an account that accepted their 18+ terms. Remove the key and browsing returns to safe mode immediately.
adult.affirm: I am 18 or older, and I am asking to see adult content.
adult.needKey: Save your own Civitai API key above first — without one this setting cannot take effect.
adult.saveFailed: Could not save that setting. 18+ is still off.
